services.desc: In the current list of the 10 most frightening things in the world, death ranks #6, while fear of speaking in front of others ranks #1. Our goal is to attack this problem so that it is NEVER a challenge for our students! We see two type of young people at Acting Up: those who seem to be a little more reserved (shy), and those who unabashedly take life head on, but forget to watch out for others! We aim to bring both a little closer to the middle! ;-) We use Creative Drama, Improvisation, and Theatre Games to help kids relax and begin to "perform" in front of each other.
